ns2:course.label: Seminar in Bioanthropology
ns2:course.description: Seminar designed to involve students in the theoretical and methodological approaches to problem areas in physical anthropology. May be repeated. Prerequisite: ANTH 440, ANTH 441, or ANTH 443; consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated. Prerequisite: ANTH 440, ANTH 441, or ANTH 443; consent of instructor.
